decisions.reason: Identifies PID 42432 as the dsh web host holding the loaded koffi.node binary and explains EBUSY during npm copy until the host exits.
Explains browser refresh does not stop the host, then gives the ordered stop relevant dsh processes, confirm exit, run install, restart, and verify flow.
Explains bare install follows latest at 0.1.1-rc.2 while alpha points to 0.1.2-alpha.5, causing downgrade rather than preserving alpha.4.
Provides exact npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 with the TUI plugin, verifies dsh --version, and restarts the host.
Tells README authors to pin exact intended core versions, avoid bare latest over prerelease installs, and keep stop-host and version verification steps.
